desc: Ideate the reduction: ans = T0 - sum_{k>=1} T_k/2^k where T0=(N+1)S and T_k = sum of (A_i+A_j) over i<=j with 2^k | (A_i+A_j); only k up to (2*maxA).bit_length()-1 matter.
Derive the per-level closed form T_k = sum_i A_i*cnt[(-A_i) mod 2^k] + (sum of A_i whose residue mod 2^k is self-inverse), handling i=j and unordered pairs correctly.
Implement the algorithm and I/O; subtract each T_k >> k from T0 and print (hybrid list/dict for memory).
Validate on samples 1-3 (expected 5, 384, 20241214) and edge cases N=1, all-equal values, A_i near 1e7 -- all passed.
